observations.behavior: Documentation and implementation rename: the authorization API and its contract were renamed from `list_resources` to `list_objects`, and the contract type from `ResourceIds` to `ObjectIds`. This unifies the terminology across the authorization and HogQL access-control layers.
observations.code_quote: return rollout.list_objects(resource, action, subject, context, limit, creator_exempt, user_access_control)
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk changes the backend authorization facade to call the renamed OpenFGA-compatible listing function. The HogQL printer and database access layers depend on this facade, so the rename propagates to query-time access control. This could support a broader, consistent access-control implementation across dashboards, insights, and HogQL queries, rather than a narrow, local change
